description: Universal Health Services, Inc.'s principal business is owning and operating, through its subsidiaries, acute care hospitals and outpatient facilities and behavioral health care facilities, and as of February 25, 2026 it owned and/or operated 375 inpatient facilities and 168 outpatient and other facilities located in 40 states, Washington, D.C., the United Kingdom and Puerto Rico. Its U.S. acute care facilities include 29 inpatient acute care hospitals, 35 free-standing emergency departments, 13 outpatient centers and 1 surgical hospital, and its behavioral health care facilities, 346 inpatient facilities and 119 outpatient facilities, include in the U.S. 182 inpatient and 110 outpatient behavioral health care facilities, and in the U.K. 161 inpatient and 2 outpatient behavioral health care facilities.
